leave_one_system_out.p_method: design-t (df=47) two-sided; NOT the svycoxph summary Pr(>|z|) column which mis-reported drop-CV as 0.089
leave_one_system_out.finding: D_body mortality signal beyond age+sex+A_body is ROBUST to dropping ANY single organ system: all six leave-one-out versions significant at design-df p<0.05 (max p=0.0032, drop-Cardiovascular; others p<3e-3 to 5e-21). Dropping Cardiovascular attenuates D most (HR 1.29->1.09) -> the CV gap is D's single largest contributor, but the signal is genuinely multi-system and does not collapse on removing any one clock.

survey_weighted_cv_cindex.method: 10-fold CV, folds at PSU level within strata (clusters not split); svycoxph trained per fold; survey-weighted concordance (reverse=TRUE) on held-out fold
survey_weighted_cv_cindex.finding: Out-of-fold survey-weighted deltaC(+D_body)=+0.0042 (per-fold paired-t p=5e-4, CI +0.0027..+0.0058), matching prior bootstrap +0.0041. D's mortality increment beyond A survives cross-validation under the survey design.
